evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies PSBT generation in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and descriptor parsing.
rationale: Fills missing BIP 174 PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB fields that prevent hardware signers from verifying multisig scripts. As noted in issue #27583, devices like BitBox02 fail to sign Core-generated multisig PSBTs and coordinators like Specter are forced to manually inject xpubs.
